Maya (Support): Escalating P1 -> client HorizonCart trial seeing repeated 429s on embedding ingestion since 11:07 UTC; onboarding smoke tests failing. Demo at 15:30 local.
Ethan (CSM): Ack. Is the demo blocked?
Maya (Support): Yes — QA can't complete import. Snippet: `2026-04-01T11:06:48Z ERROR ingest tenant=horizoncart status=429 reason=quota_exhausted`
Zack (SRE): I see a short burst of concurrent writes + retry loops from their importer. I can open a temporary allowance on the dedicated pool for horizoncart and enable short backpressure headers.
Renee (CS Ops): Do the quota bump to remove demo risk. Also we need a short comms note for the customer and renewal-watch flag: HorizonCart is high expansion potential.
Ethan (CSM): Draft status please: apology, mitigation, request to pause retries, ETA for confirmation. Customer wants update by 14:00.
Maya (Support): Draft: "Hi Lea — quick update: we identified transient quota exhaustion impacting your embed ingest. We applied a temporary quota increase and are monitoring; 429 errors have decreased. Please pause automated retries for 45 minutes while we stabilize. We're prioritizing your demo and will confirm readiness by 14:00 UTC. Apologies for the disruption — Maya, Support (Redwood)."
Ethan (CSM): Add a line promising a post-mortem within 24h and offer a 10-min pre-demo sync at 15:20 local.
Zack (SRE): Temporary +30% quota applied on redwood-ded-4 for horizoncart. Monitoring: error rate down in last 90s. Creating INC-2026-033-99.
Pager Bot: Incident INC-2026-033-99 created and assigned to Zack.
Renee (CS Ops): Action items: Ethan send status by 13:50 UTC, Zack collect KV churn diffs and revert quota when safe, Maya update support KB with retry guidance, CS Ops to tag account as renewal-watch and loop SE for a post-demo enablement.
Ethan (CSM): Sending the note now and scheduling pre-demo check. Thanks all — will update thread after customer reply. :pray:
